method: Manual source review; source-window/recovery decisions transcribed into per-fingerprint records. Existing Kan/Dittofeed labels are identified explicitly; source-reviewed candidates with unresolved contracts remain needs-triage. MW9001 is a limitation, never a defect.

reviews.notes: Coverage notice, not a bug claim. `signIn(…)` runs after `db.insert(user)` (via `createUser(validatedData.email, validatedData.password)`) has committed; Midwrite does not know whether it has side effects of its own No safety or upstream defect is inferred from it.

The route first creates an empty chat and then stores its first message. An empty chat after a failed request is recoverable by sending a message to the existing chat; unlike deletion, existing contents are not destroyed.
